summary.en: A pair of brackets touching in the centre springs apart with one overshoot; the title is revealed between their inner edges like a curtain.
summary.zh: 一对紧贴的小括号在正中弹开、放大到标题级，标题像幕布一样从两只括号之间被拉开。

fits: A short name revealed as the thing itself: a product, an API or a defined term on a title card or a chapter opening; one sign doing the whole reveal.
notFor: Sentences, or names over about 14 characters (7 in Chinese); more than once a film (its one overshoot is the accent); products with nothing to do with code or naming.

intent.en: The name is "bracketed out" as the content itself, so the viewer reads it as the thing being defined, with a developer's accent.
intent.zh: 名字被一对括号“括出来”，让观众把它读成被定义的那个东西本身，自带开发者语感。

content.en: One short name or term, centred on one line (≤ 14 chars); nothing else.
content.zh: 一个短名字或术语，单行居中（≤ 7 字）；不需要别的。

fits.zh: 一个短名字被当作“东西本身”揭示：标题字卡或章节开场上的产品名、API 或术语；一个符号完成整个揭示。

notFor.zh: 句子，或超过约 14 个字符（中文 7 字）的名字；一支片用两次以上（唯一的过冲就是重音）；和代码、命名都不沾边的产品。

en: The word is clipped, not scaled: a longer name gets its ends cut by the braces unless the half-width grows too.
The word always shows from the middle out: keep it one short, centred line; lopsided lines reveal awkwardly.
Keep its overshoot the only one around it; other springs nearby cheapen it.
zh: 字是被裁出来的而不是缩放：名字一长两头就被括号切掉，除非同步加大半宽。
字总是从中间往两边露：用居中的单行短词，左右不对称的句子露得别扭。
让它的过冲是附近唯一的过冲，周围再叠弹簧就贬值了。

upstream.name: 括号拉幕
upstream.summary: 一对紧贴的小花括号先在正中出现，随即带一次过冲向左右弹开并放大到标题级，文字 clip 宽度严格绑括号内缘、像被拉开幕布般从中间揭示，落定后字距再细微松弛
upstream.use: 开发者/技术产品的标题字卡；章节开场；需要"一个符号完成揭示"的极简一拍
upstream.energy: 中（单次过冲是唯一峰值，其余静止）

overlaps.note: split-open opens a seam between two whole panes; brace-open opens a curtain on one word between two glyphs
